dialogue.text: Around January 6th comes Shahan, Minor cold.
dialogue.zh: 大約在一月六日是小寒節氣。
dialogue.local: Around January 6th comes Shahan, Minor cold.
dialogue.en: Around January 6th comes Shahan, Minor cold.

dialogue.text: Despite its name, this is often the coldest time of the year.
dialogue.zh: 雖然名字是小寒，但這通常是一年中最冷的時候。
dialogue.ja: 名前に反して、これは一年で最も寒い時期であることが多いです。
dialogue.local: Despite its name, this is often the coldest time of the year.
dialogue.en: Despite its name, this is often the coldest time of the year.

dialogue.ja: 息が白い霧になります。

dialogue.text: Children start counting the nine nines of winter.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們開始數冬天的九九。
dialogue.ja: 子供たちは冬の九九を数え始めます。
dialogue.local: Children start counting the nine nines of winter.
dialogue.en: Children start counting the nine nines of winter.

dialogue.text: From the winter solstice, they count 81 days in nine groups of nine.
dialogue.zh: 從冬至開始，他們將81天分成九個九天來計數。
dialogue.ja: 冬至から81日間を9つの9日間のグループに分けて数えます。
dialogue.local: From the winter solstice, they count 81 days in nine groups of nine.
dialogue.en: From the winter solstice, they count 81 days in nine groups of nine.

dialogue.text: By the time they finish counting, spring will arrive.
dialogue.zh: 當他們數完時，春天就會到來。
dialogue.ja: 数え終わる頃には春が訪れます。
dialogue.local: By the time they finish counting, spring will arrive.
dialogue.en: By the time they finish counting, spring will arrive.

dialogue.text: People eat warm lamb soup and spicy hot pot.
dialogue.zh: 人們吃溫暖的羊肉湯和辣火鍋。
dialogue.ja: 人々は温かいラムスープや辛い火鍋を食べます。
dialogue.local: People eat warm lamb soup and spicy hot pot.
dialogue.en: People eat warm lamb soup and spicy hot pot.

dialogue.text: The coldest winter makes us appreciate warmth the most.
dialogue.zh: 最冷的冬天讓我們最能體會溫暖的珍貴。
dialogue.ja: 最も寒い冬は、私たちに温かさのありがたみを教えてくれます。
dialogue.local: The coldest winter makes us appreciate warmth the most.
dialogue.en: The coldest winter makes us appreciate warmth the most.
